setup: This is a conversion between scientific notation and a standard number.

steps.say: To write a standard number in scientific notation, shift the point until exactly one nonzero digit sits to its left. From [[std]] that leaves [[coeff]], the point having moved [[places]] place(s).
To undo scientific notation, shift the point back by the power of ten: [[coeff]] × 10^[[exp]] moves it [[places]] place(s) [[direction]], giving [[std]].
